Looking at the code and the error message, I can identify several issues that need to be fixed:

1. The scratchpad layout is incorrect - B tiles are being placed incorrectly
2. The MVIN operations have incorrect block lengths and addressing
3. The result reading logic has incorrect stride calculations
4. Padding handling is not properly aligned with hardware requirements

Let me fix these issues:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized via Stationary Operand Caching.
void solution(void) {
  // Pre-format scale factor matrices to eliminate CPU-side staging in the hot loop
  static uint8_t A_scales_perf[BLOCKS_M][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];
  static uint8_t B_scales_perf[BLOCKS_N][MATMUL_K / 32][BLK];

  // One-time pre-formatting before main loops start
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK;
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK;
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int i = 0; i < mrows; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK + i];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int i = mrows; i < BLK; i++) {
        A_scales_perf[i0][g][i] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK;
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK;
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Only copy actual data, handle partial blocks correctly
      for (int j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK + j];
      }
      // Pad with zeros for partial blocks if needed
      for (int j = ncols; j < BLK; j++) {
        B_scales_perf[j0][g][j] = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
    if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
    if (mrows <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Ceiling division for tiles
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t a_base = 0;

    // Configure execution once per row block
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

    // Load stationary A scale factors once per row block
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_perf[i0][0][0], A_S_BYTES, 0);

    // Keep A tiles stationary in the lower half of the scratchpad
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        // Load A tiles with proper block length (up to MAX_BLOCK_LEN=4)
        int remaining_k_tiles = tiles_K - k;
        int block_len = (remaining_k_tiles > MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? MAX_BLOCK_LEN : remaining_k_tiles;
        if (block_len > 0) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, block_len * DIM, DIM);
          k += block_len - 1; // Adjust loop counter
        }
      }
    }

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
      if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
      if (ncols <= 0) continue;

      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Ceiling division for tiles
      // Correct B base placement at the top of scratchpad
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K * tiles_J * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0; // Use beginning of accumulator space
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;

      // Load dynamic B scale factors
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_perf[j0][0][0], B_S_BYTES, 1);

      // Load dynamic B tiles into the upper half of the scratchpad
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
          // Load B tiles with proper block length (up to MAX_BLOCK_LEN=4)
          int remaining_j_tiles = tiles_J - j;
          int block_len = (remaining_j_tiles > MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? MAX_BLOCK_LEN : remaining_j_tiles;
          if (block_len > 0) {
            gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                   b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, block_len * DIM, DIM);
            j += block_len - 1; // Adjust loop counter
          }
        }
      }

      gemmini_config_st(ncols * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      
      // Perform computation utilizing the stationary A tiles and new B tiles
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // Drain results to DRAM - properly calculate the number of BF16 elements
      int total_bf16_elements = mrows * ncols;
      int bf16_per_word = 4; // 4 BF16 values per uint64 word
      int words_to_read = (total_bf16_elements + bf16_per_word - 1) / bf16_per_word;
      
      // Read in chunks to handle the data properly
      gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint64_t)(&C_hw[i0 * BLK][j0 * BLK]), SPAD_DEST * 16, total_bf16_elements);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
